kind: pre-registered proposal (policy); non-monetary badges; not an official NFL fact
summary: Two-stage reward rule. Stage 1 (proper-score qualification) awards a Verified Signal badge when a strategy's Brier skill lower bound is > 0, its BH-adjusted p-value is < 0.05 (and it clears Bonferroni 0.05/N_tests), and its decided-bet sample is >= 200, on a frozen walk-forward window. Stage 2 (prospective CLV/ROI escrow) awards the Top Single Bet / Top Parlay / Top Player Prop Combo badge to the rank-1 eligible strategy whose prospective ROI lower bound is > 0. No badge is awarded if no strategy qualifies.

tracks.name: Single bet
tracks.reason: no strategy in this track clears all three Stage-1 conditions (data/strat/proper_score.json any_eligible=false)

tracks.name: Parlay
tracks.reason: no strategy in this track clears all three Stage-1 conditions; the parlay market is additionally not scored (no validated joint probability, data/strat/proper_score.json)

tracks.name: Player prop combo
tracks.reason: no strategy in this track clears all three Stage-1 conditions; the player-prop market is not scored (no official or book-level price, data/strat/proper_score.json)

badges_awarded_note: None. The rule is frozen and waiting for a strategy that clears Stage 1. A winner is never fabricated.
stage2_rule: Rank Stage-1-qualified strategies by prospective CLV lower bound, then prospective ROI lower bound; award the track badge to rank 1 whose prospective ROI lower bound is > 0.
demotion: A badged strategy returns to paper if it trips demotion rule D1-D5 (data/strat/demotion_rules.json). Re-promotion requires a fresh prospective sample of 200 settled bets clearing D1-D3 in the opposite direction.

mind_changers.upside: A strategy earns the Verified Signal badge when its Brier skill lower bound is > 0, its BH-adjusted p-value is < 0.05 (and clears Bonferroni 0.05/N_tests), and its decided-bet sample is >= 200 on a frozen walk-forward window; a track badge follows when its prospective ROI lower bound is > 0 over the registered escrow window.
mind_changers.downside: A badge is withdrawn when the skill lower bound falls to <= 0, or the BH-adjusted p-value rises to >= 0.05, or the sample falls below the track floor, or any demotion rule D1-D5 trips.
